Start by checking the size guide on each product page. You’ll find a “Size Guide” link next to the size selector, which gives measurements and fit details for that specific style.
Review the product description and fit guidance. For example, jeans should fit comfortably at the waist and allow easy movement, while suits should fit well on the shoulders and follow your natural shape.
If sizing is important, measure yourself. For suits, focus on chest, waist, hips, and inside leg. If you’re between sizes, it’s best to size up and tailor down.
For extra confidence, you can try items in-store. In-store fitting is especially helpful for suits.

Sent · Just now

Barkers AI Agent · AI

Barkers AI Agent · AI says:

Returning an item if you change your mind is straightforward.

For online purchases, you have 30 days from delivery to return your item. Online orders come with a free prepaid courier label for returns. You can return items either in-store or by sending them to the online returns centre, starting the process through the online returns portal.

For in-store purchases, simply return the item to any Barkers store with your proof of purchase.

All purchases can be refunded, exchanged, or credited within 14 days. Between 14 and 30 days, you can exchange or receive store credit.

Items must be in original, unwashed condition with all labels and swing tags attached.

Once received, returns are processed within 1 to 2 days at the warehouse, or up to 5 business days for Australian returns.
